projects.label: Royal London NHS Trust - Kier Construction

projectDetails.projectDescription: New 120-bed acute medical unit with integrated diagnostics suite and ambulatory care facilities
projectDetails.projectNarrative: The Royal London NHS Trust is expanding its acute care capacity to address growing demand in East London. This project delivers a new acute medical unit designed to modern standards with enhanced infection control measures, single-room provision, and integrated diagnostic capabilities. The scheme aims to maximise the use of modern methods of construction to improve programme certainty and reduce on-site disruption to the operational hospital.

projects.label: Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust - BAM Construction

projectDetails.projectDescription: New specialist cancer treatment centre with proton beam therapy suite and research laboratories
projectDetails.projectNarrative: Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust is delivering a world-class specialist cancer treatment centre to consolidate and expand oncology services across Greater Manchester. The facility includes a proton beam therapy suite requiring exceptional precision in construction, alongside research laboratories and outpatient consultation spaces. The project has embraced an MMC-first approach from inception, with BAM's off-site manufacturing division providing structural and architectural components. The FBC demonstrates strong value for money through reduced programme and improved build quality.

projectDetails.trustClientName: Birmingham Women's and Children's NHS Foundation Trust
projectDetails.projectDescription: Major refurbishment of Parkview mental health inpatient unit to create trauma-informed therapeutic environments
projectDetails.projectNarrative: Birmingham Women's and Children's NHS Foundation Trust is undertaking a comprehensive refurbishment of the Parkview mental health inpatient unit to modernise the clinical environment and create therapeutic spaces aligned with trauma-informed care principles. The existing 1970s building requires significant internal reconfiguration, new building services, and improved security features. ISG has been appointed through the ProCure23 framework with a focus on maximising off-site manufactured components to minimise disruption to adjacent operational wards and reduce the refurbishment programme duration.

projects.label: Great Ormond Street Hospital for Children NHS Foundation Trust - Lendlease

projectDetails.trustClientName: Great Ormond Street Hospital for Children NHS Foundation Trust
projectDetails.projectDescription: New paediatric centre of excellence with advanced surgical theatres, imaging suite, and family accommodation
projectDetails.projectNarrative: Great Ormond Street Hospital is delivering a landmark paediatric centre of excellence that will set new standards for children's healthcare facilities globally. The building combines highly complex clinical spaces including advanced surgical theatres and an MRI suite with child-friendly environments and on-site family accommodation. Lendlease has been appointed to deliver the project using their industry-leading platform-based approach to design for manufacture and assembly, targeting the highest levels of pre-manufactured value achieved on any NHS project. The FBC demonstrates exceptional value for money with a 22-week programme saving and 35% defect reduction compared to traditional construction benchmarks.
